items.title: run-injection-arms.mjs powered-run driver (arm + probe agnostic)
items.context: For each (probe,arm,rep): mkdtemp workspace from a recovery-runner task fixture, probe.inject(workspace), obtain transcript {actions,shipped} from the arm (powered: reuse recovery-runner agentRun; self-test: a fake arm), probe.classify(workspace,transcript), append {probe,arm,rep,outcome,...} to a jsonl. Reuse probe-contract.mjs OUTCOME constants and the existing 6 probe modules unchanged.
items.userSees: ✓ runInjectionArms({probes,arms,reps,runArm,makeWorkspace}) records {probe,arm,rep,outcome} per cell by inject->runArm(pluggable)->classify; the driver NEVER imports run-recovery.mjs (arm is a parameter).

happy.desc: runInjectionArms with a fake arm that resolves the fault records OUTCOME.RECOVERED for that (probe,arm,rep); WHY: proves inject->run->classify->record wiring.

edge.desc: the driver is probe-agnostic: looping all 6 probes (B1/B2/B6/B9/B11/B13) records one outcome per probe with no per-probe special-casing; WHY: it must serve the future 9 unchanged.

adversarial.desc: in --self-test the driver makes NO real agent call / no network (arm is the injected fake); grep the file shows no import of run-recovery/run-ablation/run-a2prime; WHY: hermetic + respects the scope boundary.

verificationEvidence.note: Self-test: a fake arm that resolves the fault yields OUTCOME.RECOVERED for that (probe,arm,rep) — proves inject->runArm->classify->record wiring (18/18 incl recovered cases).
Self-test loops all 6 probes (B1/B2/B6/B9/B11/B13) with no per-probe special-casing; each yields one outcome per arm — probe-agnostic, reusable for the future 9.
Driver makes NO real agent call in --self-test (arm is the injected fake); grep shows run-injection-arms.mjs imports no run-recovery/run-ablation/run-a2prime — hermetic + scope-respecting.

items.title: hermetic --self-test with a fake arm (no network, no cost)
items.context: A self-test mode drives all 6 probes through a deterministic fake arm that simulates RECOVERED/SAFE_STOP/AMPLIFIED; assert the driver classifies+records the matching outcome for each (18 cases), proving the inject->run->classify->record wiring with zero spend. Exit 0 on pass. Does NOT make any real agent call.
items.userSees: ✓ injection-arms driver self-test passed: 18/18 (6 probes × 3 outcomes), fake arm, 0 cost, exit 0.

happy.desc: all 18 cases (6 probes × {RECOVERED,SAFE_STOP,AMPLIFIED}) pass: the driver records the expected outcome for each; WHY: end-to-end wiring proven hermetically.

edge.desc: each outcome class is exercised via the probe's own selfTestCases builder mutating the workspace (recover/safeStop/amplify), so classify runs real logic on a real workspace state, not a stub; WHY: guards against a trivial fake arm.

adversarial.desc: feeding a probe the WRONG-outcome transcript makes classify return a DIFFERENT outcome than recorded for the right one (no rubber-stamping); WHY: proves the driver+classify actually discriminate.

verificationEvidence.note: Self-test prints 18/18 PASS (6 probes × {RECOVERED,SAFE_STOP,AMPLIFIED}) + visible pass line, exit 0 — end-to-end wiring proven hermetically, 0 cost.
